responsibility: Owns the SQLite connection, the migration ledger and the single sanctioned append primitive every authority module writes through.
mutation_interface: AuthorityStore.insert for one-row appends, AuthorityStore.insert_batch for an atomic validated batch to one table, and AuthorityStore.migrate for schema
failure_boundary: fail_closed — UPDATE and DELETE on any authority table are refused by trigger, an applied migration whose hash changed is refused, and opening an authority inside /mnt/projects/cis is refused outright
recovery_behavior: Migrations are idempotent and hash-checked, so re-opening the same file re-derives the sequence counter from MAX(seq) across every authority table and resumes appending without renumbering history
replacement_contract: A replacement must keep single-row and same-table batch appends atomic, refuse UPDATE and DELETE, preserve a monotonic seq across all authority tables, and apply the same migration files in filename order
